name: 箱包功能证据图

prompt_template.subject: {product_description}
prompt_template.evidence: derive structure only from {evidence_description}; do not infer hidden or unsupported features
prompt_template.lighting: neutral-cool studio lighting with directional side light preserving dark textile texture and edge separation
prompt_template.composition: {layout_variant}; keep the bag as the focal point with short callouts anchored to the exact visible feature
prompt_template.quality: high-fidelity commercial e-commerce infographic, mobile-readable, exact product identity

defaults.feature: one user-confirmed or reference-visible bag feature
defaults.evidence: the supplied product reference images and user-confirmed product data
defaults.lighting: neutral-cool studio lighting with soft directional side light
defaults.composition: product left-center with a disciplined headline and callout column

overrides.composition: front-facing slight 3/4 bag view occupying 48-55%, with 4-5 short callouts aligned in one side column
overrides.feature: only visible or confirmed compartments, pockets, zipper paths, and access points

overrides.composition: bag on the left occupying 42-48%, confirmed compatible objects aligned on the right, with no pure flat-lay treatment
overrides.feature: only confirmed compatible objects, capacity values, and size claims

rear-comfort-proof.description: 背负系统与透气结构证据

overrides.composition: straight rear bag view occupying 52-58%, with up to two circular magnified details, directional arrows, and three compact bottom icons
overrides.feature: only reference-visible or confirmed shoulder straps, adjusters, padding, mesh, and back-panel structures

travel-security-proof.description: 旅行固定与防盗结构证据

overrides.composition: rear or rear three-quarter bag view occupying 55-62%, with one contextual proof object or one magnified inset and up to three short labels
overrides.feature: only confirmed trolley sleeves, luggage attachments, hidden rear pockets, zipper locations, or security structures

category_tips.backpacks: preserve the exact pocket count, zipper routes, straps, adjusters, back padding, side pockets, trolley sleeves and hidden-pocket placement from the supplied references
category_tips.travel-bags: show luggage attachment or security access only when the corresponding product structure is visible or explicitly confirmed
category_tips.handbags: use callouts for visible closures, handles, straps and compartments; do not infer an unseen interior

examples: Evidence-led e-commerce bag feature infographic, square 1:1. Preserve the exact supplied backpack identity. Front-facing slight 3/4 view on the left occupying 52% of the canvas. Add five short callouts in one aligned right column, each anchored to a visible compartment or zipper path from the reference. Clean #F4F4F4 background, neutral-cool side lighting, at least 30% whitespace. Use only confirmed text. No invented interior, hidden pocket, capacity number, fake logo, extra zipper, watermark, or unsupported claim.

Evidence-led backpack capacity infographic, square 1:1. Place the exact supplied backpack on the left occupying 46%. Arrange only user-confirmed compatible objects on the right in a clean aligned layout, with three short top icons. Use #F4F4F4 background and consistent neutral-cool lighting. Do not use a pure overhead flat lay. No invented laptop size, volume, object count, certification, extra pocket, fake logo, watermark, or unsupported text.

Evidence-led rear carrying-system infographic, square 1:1. Use the supplied rear reference as the structural source. Straight rear backpack view occupying 56%, two circular macro insets for confirmed strap and back-panel details, three compact bottom icons, and directional callout arrows. Maintain 30% whitespace and exact strap geometry. No invented ventilation claim, orthopedic claim, hidden pocket, extra padding, fake logo, watermark, or unsupported text.

Evidence-led travel and security bag infographic, square 1:1. Show the exact rear three-quarter bag view occupying 58%. If a trolley sleeve is confirmed, show it physically engaging a luggage handle; if a hidden rear pocket is confirmed, use one magnified inset anchored to its exact location. Include no more than three short labels. Do not combine mutually unsupported features, invent a sleeve or pocket, redesign the back panel, add random travel props, or render unconfirmed claims.
anti_ai_tips: Keep callout endpoints attached to real seams, pockets, zippers, straps or hardware visible in the references. A magnified inset must reproduce the same structure, material, color and orientation as its source area.

composition_rules.layout: 标题区 + 产品证据区 + 单列标注/放大框/图标区；每页只证明一个功能主题

angles.prompt: front-facing at a slight three-quarter angle
straight rear view, camera parallel to the back panel
rear three-quarter view exposing the confirmed back feature

text_rules.headline: 主标题 28-42pt，现代无衬线粗体，#111111，最多两行
text_rules.feature_heading: 功能标题 11-15pt，现代无衬线半粗体，#111111，每项不超过 24 个拉丁字符
text_rules.feature_body: 说明 9-12pt，现代无衬线常规体，#3A3A3A，最多两行
text_rules.callouts: 引导线与圆形放大框 2-3px，使用模板功能强调色 hex；每页最多 5 个标注
text_rules.evidence: 尺寸、容量、兼容物品、拉杆带、防盗袋、透气和人体工学等文字仅使用用户确认数据

pitfalls: 把风格参考中的功能当成当前产品事实（只允许使用产品参考图可见或用户明确确认的结构与声明）
背面、侧面或内部结构被模型补画（缺对应参考图时停止该功能页或使用证据占位，不生成猜测结构）
引导线或放大框没有落在真实结构上（端点必须锚定可见的车线、口袋、拉链、肩带或五金）
容量页退化成纯平铺或物品喧宾夺主（产品保持 42-48%，物品只在右侧对齐且必须已确认）
旅行道具制造虚假功能关系（行李箱、拉杆或护照只在证明已确认功能时出现，不作随机装饰）
